rules.description: Convert each entered temperature to °F using temperature_units.json before comparison.
Evaluate minimum design temperature and maximum design temperature independently when both are supplied.
Match all records whose inclusive/exclusive boundaries contain the converted temperature.
rules.expression: (min_f is null or temperature_f > min_f or (min_inclusive and temperature_f == min_f)) and (max_f is null or temperature_f < max_f or (max_inclusive and temperature_f == max_f))

rules.description: When multiple records share an alternative_group_id, return every alternative. Do not rank one as technically preferred.
Return only requested component types, while retaining the full source record for audit traceability.
If a requested component is not specified in the source, return incomplete_source_data and a blocking engineering-review message.
Any ambiguous source text blocks automatic recommendation.
Service-condition flags generate warnings only and cannot select or reject a material in Release 1.
If minimum and maximum temperatures lead to different families, display both results and require materials engineering resolution.
No source match results in outside_guide_range.
The app must never issue an approved or final material decision automatically.
A user override requires a reason, comment, name and date.
rules.expression: if override then require(override_reason, override_comment, overridden_by, override_date)
